 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

01.
2. Learned counsel for the Petitioners files additional affidavit on behalf of the Petitioners in Court today, which is taken on record.

The Petitioners have filed this writ petition seeking direction to the Opposite Parties to declare the Land Acquisition Notifications published on 28.11.2018 as lapsed/ineffective for non-awarding the compensation within 12 months or in the alternative, award the compensation as per the provisions of RFCTLARR Act, 2013, in favour of the Petitioners as per the present market value of the land under different Kisam at par with Jeypore L.R.
5.

In course of hearing, learned counsel for the Petitioner states that highlighting their grievance, the Petitioners have made representation to Opposite Party No.3 vide Annexure-3 and the same may be directed to be considered within a stipulated time taking into consideration the Annexure-4, to which learned counsel for the State has no objection.

6. As agreed by learned counsel for the parties and after going through the records, this Court,
without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, disposes of the Writ Petition directing Opposite Party No.3 to consider the representation filed by the petitioner vide Annexure-3, and pass appropriate order in accordance with law taking into consideration the Annexure-4 series within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
